Package dev.opencollab.paletter.item.component

Interface ItemsOrTags

All Known Implementing Classes:
ItemsOrTags.Items, ItemsOrTags.TagQuery
public sealed interface ItemsOrTags permits ItemsOrTags.Items, ItemsOrTags.TagQuery
The value of an add-on JSON field that takes one of several forms:
  • ItemsOrTags.Items: the identifiers of the items
  • ItemsOrTags.TagQuery: a Molang query.any_tag expression that selects items by tag

Switch over it without a default: the records below are all its forms.

Used by: item:minecraft:repairable:repair_items[].items.
